_comment: ONTOLOGY CONTRACT — generated from standard/profiles/** by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/osf/gen-contract.mjs; do not edit by hand. For agents and sink validators: ONLY these node labels (with their key property) and ONLY these relationship triples may be written to a knowledge graph. Anything not listed here is non-conformant — extend the profile first, then regenerate. Background: docs/agent-conformance.md.

identity.rule: Machine/equipment nodes MUST use their profile kgNodeLabel with the key property declared in nodes.* below — never invent node identities from source-local ids (machineId, machineNo, pool names, vendor names); those are attributes at most.
identity.decided: OWNER 2026-09-24: the machine key is element_id (instance codes along the partOf chain of sites/<site>/instances). Since core 3.0.0 every relationship to a machine names element_id and machine_id is no key alias any more. Do not mix both in one graph.

unresolvedTargets._comment: Relationship targets declared in profiles that do not (yet) resolve to a kgNodeLabel in this repo. Each entry is consolidation work: add the missing profile or fix the target name. New entries should not be added.

treeTargets._comment: Relationship targets that are equipment levels of the instance tree (instance-schema equipmentLevel): the edge resolves through the partOf chain of sites/<site>/instances, no targetIdProp (resolvedBy: instances).

aliases._comment: Observed non-conformant vocabulary (agent-conformance test 2026-07-09) -> conformant repo form. Never write the left side. Note: RESPONDS_TO, TRIGGERS, FOR_* ARE conformant repo vocabulary (see edges); ON_MACHINE and EXECUTED_AT are retired (only ISA-95 edges).
aliases.AT_WORKCENTER: plan: ProductionOrder MADE_UP_OF SegmentRequirement REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT Machine (or JobOrder REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT); actual: OperationsResponse MADE_UP_OF SegmentResponse ACTUAL_EQUIPMENT Machine
aliases.RUNS_ON: plan: ProductionOrder MADE_UP_OF SegmentRequirement REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT Machine (or JobOrder REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT); actual: OperationsResponse MADE_UP_OF SegmentResponse ACTUAL_EQUIPMENT Machine
aliases.Workcenter: use the machine profile kgNodeLabel (e.g. CNC_Machine, Machine) with its declared key
aliases.Serial: MaterialLot/Quant level (serialized part) — profile pending, see docs/agent-conformance.md

edgeAliases._comment: Old edge names from W8-RENAME (standard 2.0.0) resolve to the ISA-95 type, or to reverseOf read backwards; they are read, never written.
